appliance_factory.description: Manufacturing and regulated deployments: golden images, offline update bundles, strict policy gates, and long-term rebuildability.
appliance_factory.label: D) Appliance factory / regulatory
required_invariants: Strict admission gates and stable audit evidence exports

fleet_host.description: Minimal, rollbackable control plane host that runs workloads as derived, signed jails/microVM artifacts and prioritizes remote operability at scale.
fleet_host.label: A) Secure fleet host
notes: Prefer Linux compatibility via Linux-in-microVM adapters rather than syscall translation.

general_os.description: Developer-friendly general OS posture that keeps Derive core small but offers practical adapters and tooling for broad software availability.
forbidden_by_default: Forked 'classic' configuration pathways that bypass the derive pipeline
general_os.label: C) General-purpose OS
required_invariants: Derive pipeline remains the primary interface
Explainability of system state remains intact

workstation.description: Human-facing workstation with strong app isolation, portal-mediated resources, and ergonomic permission flows while retaining derivation + rollback.
forbidden_by_default: Direct device passthrough without policy + receipts
workstation.label: B) Secure workstation
required_invariants: Clear trusted UI boundary / secure attention path
Data-at-rest protection appropriate for lost-device threat model
Explainers for 'why does this app have access?'
